sloka: पितु: सत्यं प्रतिश्रुत्य हत्वा भरतमागतम्।किं करिष्ऺयामि राज्येन सापवादेन लक्ष्मण ॥ २.९७.३॥
transliteration: pitu: satyaṁ pratiśrutya hatvā bharatamāgatam।kiṁ kariṣऺyāmi rājyena sāpavādena lakṣmaṇa ॥ 2.97.3॥

translations.english: O Lakshmana, having sworn that I would make father's word true, what shall I do with the kingdom earned slanderously by slaying Bharata who has come (to see me)?
